en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a large, historic wooden building with a steep, shingled roof and two prominent chimneys. The building has two main entrances, each accessed by a staircase, and simple decorative pediments above the doors. There are two empty flagpoles in front, a few garden chairs, and well-kept gardens with shrubs and flowers. Trees are visible to the left and right, and the photo has a clear sky with some clouds. Text at the bottom left provides location information, while more text at the bottom right gives details about the photograph's copyright.
